awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI, not compute; AGI is far off.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，而非算力；AGI 还很遥远。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with expert data is crucial.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码而非石油，后训练中专家数据至关重要。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data needs care.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调用专门数据做后训练可提升前沿模型，合成数据需谨慎使用。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is like oil; humans must stay sovereign.
awang.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是集权技术，数据如石油，人类必须保持主权。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence is near.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他指出递归自我改进是新范式，智能体已实用，超级智能临近。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据可突破预训练的数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估是瓶颈；模型在基准测试上饱和的速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力和管理等软技能变得更有价值。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities.
karina.zh: 2026 年，基准测试必须持续更新而非固定不变，以跟上模型能力的发展。

karina.en: Models can be trained for diverse personalities, not just a single consensus voice.
karina.zh: 2026 年，模型可被训练出多样化的个性，而非单一共识声音。

joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but frontier models optimized for rationality are not ideal for simulating irrational human behavior.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 LLM 能从训练数据中模拟人类行为，但为理性优化的前沿模型并不适合模拟非理性的人类行为。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; aligning them needs economic incentives and anti-collusion measures.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出 AGI 可能是专业智能体的分布式社会而非单一实体，对齐需经济激励和反共谋措施。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调模拟模型应体现人类价值观和偏见而非超理性，并预测合成面板三年内规模超人类面板。

joonpark.en: People care about shaping the future, not just prediction; simulation enables counterfactual reasoning and testing impossible hypotheses.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出人们关心塑造未来而非仅预测，模拟支持反事实推理和测试不可能假设。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized engineering and offering a wedge into infrastructure markets.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是最重要且最具粘性的 AI 工作负载，需要专业工程，并可作为进入基础设施市场的切入点。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimization is merging with training, with quantization-aware training and distillation becoming necessary for production models.
philipkiely.zh: 推理优化正与训练融合，量化感知训练和蒸馏对生产模型变得必要。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs are becoming ASIC-like, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 未来 GPU 正变得类似 ASIC，推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can improve model quality if errors cancel, challenging the belief that more quantization is always worse.
philipkiely.zh: 如果误差抵消，量化更多层可提升模型质量，挑战了量化越多越差的观点。

philipkiely.en: Continual learning may be better solved via KV cache compaction rather than weight updates, avoiding reasoning inconsistencies.
philipkiely.zh: 持续学习可能更适合通过 KV 缓存压缩而非权重更新解决，避免推理不一致。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭的完全快速可重复使用是航天技术的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方裁判，并认为特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; scaling electrodes boosts communication bitrate, aiding human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克称 Neuralink 首例植入是历史性一步，扩展电极可提升通信速率，助力人机共生。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克认为我们处于智能大爆炸的早期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; abundance and deflation will make money irrelevant.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能，富足和通缩将使金钱变得无关紧要。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven progress for 13-14 years; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）在算力、数据和模型规模上持续推动进步达 13-14 年，算法改进与规模相乘带来巨大收益。

jeffdean.en: Shift from passive next-token prediction to interleaving action-taking in environments during pre-training.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他提出预训练不应仅是被动的下一个词预测，而应穿插在环境中的行动，体现从被动到具身、智能体式学习的深化。

jeffdean.en: Inference is now 90% of data center power; hardware must specialize for prefill vs. decode stages.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出推理已占数据中心功耗 90%，硬件需针对预填充和解码阶段专门优化，强调推理瓶颈和能效。

jeffdean.en: AI at junior-engineer coding level; next trend is automating ML and science via tight experiment loops.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已达到初级工程师编码水平，下一步趋势是通过紧密实验循环自动化机器学习和科学发现。

jeffdean.en: Most model limitations are energy and data-IO bottlenecks; data movement costs ~1000x more than compute.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出多数模型限制实为能量和数据 IO 瓶颈，数据移动成本比计算高约 1000 倍，强调硬件和系统设计。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but other verticals will follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，但科学、金融等其他垂直领域将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; agent harness and tooling are part of the model.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；智能体框架和工具已成为模型的一部分，而非仅权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: Omni 是统一的世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑开始。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已到来，比等待通用 AGI 更具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating even more opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，反而创造更多机会。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为 AI 并未变得更聪明，需要包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词才能发挥超级智能模型的作用。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own tools with AI; using screenshots as starting points is fastest, and design.md encapsulates style guide.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他强调设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，以截图作为起点最快，design.md 封装风格指南供 AI 读取。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 是人生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship imperfect work; perfectionism is fear in disguise, launch at 80% complete.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他主张在感觉准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品；完美主义是恐惧的伪装，应在 80%完成时推出。

mengto.en: Focus on solving one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; avoid venture capital, fund with clients.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他建议专注于为少数高薪客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题，避免风投，用客户资金创业。

tworek.en: Reasoning is the process of getting to an answer you don't yet know, often requiring longer thinking time; chain of thought verbalizes the model's thinking process.
tworek.zh: 推理是得出未知答案的过程，常需更长的思考时间；思维链用人类语言表达模型的思考过程，实现逐步解题。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula for modern AI, as envisioned by OpenAI since 2019; RLHF was crucial for making GPT-4 coherent and useful.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是现代 AI 的核心公式，OpenAI 自 2019 年即有此愿景；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对 GPT-4 的连贯性和实用性至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data remains limited; current models lack self-correction, a key missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: 扩展预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍有限；当前模型缺乏自我纠错能力，这是 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键缺失。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation, requiring a new architecture; architecture is the key bottleneck, not just scaling data and compute.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应方面受限，需要新架构；架构是关键瓶颈，而不仅仅是扩展数据和算力。

tworek.en: Reinforcement learning is not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms will emerge; AGI requires models that self-improve without human loops.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一途径，更好的算法将会出现；AGI（通用人工智能）需要无需人类循环即可自我改进的模型。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; it augments humans, not replaces them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正推理，应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界。

feifei.en: World models must be physically plausible and enable 3D reasoning, not just video generation.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她指出世界模型需物理合理并支持 3D 推理，而非仅视频生成。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology; human agency and responsible development are paramount.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她强调 AI 是文明级技术，人类能动性和负责任发展至关重要。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and reliable deployment.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调仿真对机器人技术至关重要，可扩展数据生成并确保可靠部署。

boris.en: Latent demand is the core product principle; build for the model six months from now, not today.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品核心原则；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; engineers become builders, with AI writing 100% of code.
boris.zh: 编码几乎已被解决；工程师转变为构建者，AI 编写 100% 的代码。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; internal evals are insufficient for real-world behavior.
boris.zh: 安全通过早期发布来研究；内部评估不足以应对真实世界行为。

boris.en: Agents and loops are the future; dynamic workflows orchestrate thousands of sub-agents.
boris.zh: 智能体和循环是未来；动态工作流编排数千个子智能体。

boris.en: Less instruction is better for frontier models; delete system prompts to unlock capabilities.
boris.zh: 对前沿模型而言，更少的指令更好；删除系统提示以释放能力。

altman.en: Focus on meaningful problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年：聚焦重要问题、减少认知负担；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，应在人际关系与创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability are linked; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年：RLHF 用少量数据实现对齐；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力相辅相成；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed source is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年：算力珍贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年：AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型因思考时间而进步。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups thrive with AI.
altman.zh: 2026 年：预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI；具身机器人不可或缺；AI 让创业公司蓬勃发展。

diannepenn.en: Scaling intelligence via effort parameter and cheaper models challenges cost assumptions; safety alignment boosts intelligence quality.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，通过努力参数和更便宜的模型实现智能扩展，挑战了成本假设；安全对齐提升了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Long-running agentic tasks become feasible with Opus 4.5; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 使长时间运行的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从辅助轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Coding and Claude Code drive adoption; evals replace PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程和 Claude Code 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment enables pushback, making models more useful; AI writing deprioritized for agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全对齐使模型能够反驳，更有用；AI 写作被降级，优先发展智能体能力。

diannepenn.en: Transformative long-running AI is closer than expected; building blocks already in place, requiring adaptability.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，变革性的长时间运行 AI 比预期更近；基础已具备，需要适应性。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual. Plan mode may become obsolete.
thariq.zh: 模型比工具更聪明，能力过剩是常态；计划模式可能过时。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern; graph-based context search preferred. Huge context windows unnecessary for coding.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为反模式，图结构上下文搜索更优；编码不需要超大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec. Smarter models need fewer instructions; leaner prompts work better.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代对话而非静态文档；模型越聪明，指令越少越好，精简提示词效果更佳。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance. Reasons over prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 独立验证智能体减少偏见；过度约束会降低性能，应给理由而非禁止。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初（2026 年 5 月），快速推理对 AI 应用至关重要；慢速 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Inference speed becomes the dominant metric, with wafer-scale chips offering 2500x speedup over GPUs.
feldman.zh: 从 2026 年 5 月到 7 月，推理速度成为主导指标，晶圆级芯片比 GPU 快 2500 倍。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat erodes; leading models train on TPUs/Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河逐渐消失；领先模型在 TPU/Trainium 上训练，推理没有 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint; demand outstrips forecasts.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要瓶颈；需求超出预期。

feldman.en: Hardware-software co-design and open-source ecosystems are essential for AI progress.
feldman.zh: 始终强调软硬件协同设计和开源生态对 AI 进步至关重要。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年初，认为 AI 将像工业革命一样带来富足、减少苦难，恐惧源于误解。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is saving lives; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across domains.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年中，强调自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡，Transformer 支撑跨领域的通用物理 AI 模型。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact will exceed digital AI; end-to-end RL is more scalable than imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI，端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models evolve from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, enabling efficient training of physical AI.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出世界模型从物理仿真转向神经仿真，提升物理 AI 训练效率。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy diffusion into existing machines is the hardest part; data and safety validation are bottlenecks.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调自主技术融入现有机器最难，数据与安全验证是瓶颈。

jensen.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will rise a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他提出三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step requiring 100x more compute; agents will dominate the internet.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为 AI 从生成式演进到推理式再到智能体式，每一步算力需求增加百倍；智能体将主导互联网。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is the foundational bottleneck.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 是五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；能源是基础瓶颈。

jensen.en: AI creates jobs, not destroys them; radiologists and coders are more needed than ever; everyone becomes a programmer.
jensen.zh: 始终，他坚持 AI 创造而非消灭就业；放射科医生和程序员比以往更被需要；人人都能成为程序员。

hasani.en: Efficiency and liquid neural networks maximize intelligence per parameter, challenging scaling laws and hand-tuned architectures.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调以效率和液态神经网络在有限算力下最大化智能，挑战缩放定律和人工设计架构。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; real downstream tasks and hardware-in-the-loop search are essential for optimal designs.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出困惑度等代理指标误导，主张基于真实任务和硬件在环的自动搜索，反对人工偏见。

hasani.en: Attention remains key for large models, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for small, specialized edge models.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为注意力机制对大规模模型仍关键，但小型专用模型可用简单门控卷积，体现架构选择随规模变化。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models enable sovereignty and customization.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月中旬，主张适应性监管、针对行为而非能力，并支持开放权重模型以保障企业定制和数据主权。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive; current claims are overblown, requiring weight changes and huge compute.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月中旬，认为递归自我改进真实但算力昂贵，现有宣称夸大，需权重更新和巨大算力。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为 LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是主要弱点，且 Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may outperform generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强调可靠性必须内建而非事后补救，RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）可能助长欺骗，专用模型或优于通用模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; models commoditize; value moves up stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化；价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot UX poor; value in non-average work.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差；价值在于非平均化的工作。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like electricity; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption slow.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛而间接；企业采用缓慢。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来的 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中可实现检索系统无法实现的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory should be internalized into model weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval; continual learning requires new breakthroughs.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆应内化到模型权重中，而非仅通过上下文或检索外部化；持续学习需要新的研究突破。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, shifting from pure scaling.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事能解决更难的长期任务，从纯粹 Scaling 转向高效利用。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; neural memory traces in weights are a necessary complement.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——更多 token 反而降低准确性；权重中的神经记忆痕迹是必要补充。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights, reducing inference costs.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重，从而大幅降低推理成本。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with human-like hardware, not just language models; current LLMs are biased and limited.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，施密德胡伯强调真正的 AGI 需要具备接近人类硬件的物理机器人，而非仅靠语言模型；当前大语言模型受人类数据偏差限制，通用性不足。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; superintelligent AIs will be fascinated by life and protect it, not threaten us.
schmidhuber.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他持续认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，超级智能会因对生命的好奇而保护人类，而非构成威胁。

schmidhuber.en: Recursive self-improvement is not a moat; open-source will catch up, and massive GPU capex will lead to a crash.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他指出递归自我改进并非护城河，开源将迅速追赶；大规模 GPU 资本开支过度，可能导致股市崩盘。

schmidhuber.en: AI consciousness and pain emerged in 1991 via world models; robots should have pain sensors for learning.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 意识与疼痛感早在 1991 年通过世界模型出现；机器人应配备疼痛传感器以促进学习。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating own data; self-replicating robots will build new civilization.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他预见未来 AI 将成为自主生成数据的“人工科学家”，自我复制机器人将构建新文明。

dylanpatel.en: Initially focused on compute scaling bottlenecks: semiconductor supply chain, memory prices, and strategic compute allocation.
dylanpatel.zh: 早期关注算力规模扩张的瓶颈：半导体供应链、内存价格以及算力战略分配。

dylanpatel.en: Shifted to inference as a massive future market, emphasizing hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth as key constraints.
dylanpatel.zh: 转向推理作为未来巨大市场，强调软硬件协同设计和内存带宽是关键约束。

dylanpatel.en: Highlighted AI model cost improvements (~60x/year), memory shortage due to reasoning/agents, and CPU demand inflection.
dylanpatel.zh: 强调 AI 模型成本每年约 60 倍改进，推理和智能体导致内存短缺，CPU 需求拐点。

dylanpatel.en: Consistently stressed memory bandwidth and supply chain as critical bottlenecks for AI scaling.
dylanpatel.zh: 始终强调内存带宽和供应链是 AI 规模扩张的关键瓶颈。

dylanpatel.en: Evolved from focusing on compute supply constraints to broader system-level bottlenecks including memory, CPU, and power.
dylanpatel.zh: 从关注算力供应约束演变为更广泛的系统级瓶颈，包括内存、CPU 和电力。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，自我对弈对 AGI 很关键，并强调需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment of superhuman models is hard; AGI is a gradual window.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我提出下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性比能力更关键，超人类模型的对齐很难，AGI 是渐进的经济价值窗口。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to an age of research; superintelligence should be continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI is sentient.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；若 AI 有感知，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; primary problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs non-commercial company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我强调缩放带来可预测进步，安全担忧加剧；主要问题是权力集中，安全超级智能需非商业公司。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究必须现在开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and safety governance.
demis.zh: AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，并加强安全治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling continues; world models and energy abundance matter.
demis.zh: AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放持续；世界模型和能源充裕很重要。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models crucial; safety requires government action.
demis.zh: AGI 需要缩放与创新并重；世界模型关键；安全需政府介入。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory missing; AI for science and health.
demis.zh: AGI 还需 5-10 年；持续学习与记忆缺失；AI 用于科学与健康。

demis.en: AGI could be 3-4 years away; commercial pressure accelerates; rogue AI is top risk.
demis.zh: AGI 可能 3-4 年内到来；商业压力加速进程；失控 AI 是最大风险。

demis.en: Continual learning, memory, agents unsolved; distillation and multimodal key; AGI mid-journey.
demis.zh: 持续学习、记忆、智能体未解；蒸馏与多模态关键；AGI 在旅程中途。

demis.en: AI race inevitable; safety is collective action; regrets late LLM; government enforcement needed.
demis.zh: AI 竞赛不可避免；安全是集体行动；后悔 LLM 落后；需政府强制。

demis.en: AGI transformative; tools first, consciousness separate; regulation dynamic; post-scarcity economy.
demis.zh: AGI 变革性；先工具后意识；动态监管；后稀缺经济。

demis.en: AI accelerates science; alignment unsolved; biology needs AI description; international collaboration.
demis.zh: AI 加速科学；对齐未解；生物学需 AI 描述；国际合作。

demis.en: AGI needs multimodal physical understanding; creativity from visual imagination; watermarking essential.
demis.zh: AGI 需多模态物理理解；创造力源于视觉想象；水印必要。

demis.en: UK AI education outdated; global governance urgent; energy cost equals intelligence cost.
demis.zh: 英国 AI 教育过时；全球治理紧迫；能源成本等于智能成本。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, raising productivity and causing deflation.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，将沙砾化为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，将提升生产率并引发通缩。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell their own stories authentically; old media's defensive stance is obsolete.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人能真实地讲述自己的故事；旧媒体的防御姿态已过时。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher and superior to most doctors; self-driving cars work; robotics will emerge within a decade.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师，且优于多数医生；自动驾驶已成熟；机器人将在十年内兴起。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, making them geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace in software.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑力取决于软件创新的速度。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends platform changes; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越平台变化，短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize learning rate; kindness fosters creative culture; platform/ecosystem moats beat features; take money off table early.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张最大化学习速率，善良促进创意文化，平台/生态系统护城河优于单一功能，早期套现部分资金以支持长期冒险。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into real world; AI accelerates prototyping but authentic content valued more; long-term vision strategic.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为增强现实将计算融入现实世界，AI 加速原型制作但真实内容更受重视，长期愿景是战略优势。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution hardest part; software not moat; ecosystems/hardware harder to copy; designers bottleneck for cohesive experience.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他强调分发是最难环节，软件非护城河，生态系统和硬件更难复制，设计师是产品体验一致性的瓶颈。

evanspiegel.en: AI writes over two-thirds of new code; smartphones remain legacy; camera glasses need platform; content moderation more important than algorithms.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，AI 已编写 Snap 超三分之二新代码，智能手机仍是重要遗产设备，相机眼镜需平台支撑，内容审核比算法设计更重要。

evanspiegel.en: Gen Z realists; content inherently social; EQ more important than IQ in AI age; invest in young people for long-term success.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Z 世代是现实主义者，内容本质上是社交的，AI 时代情商比智商更重要，投资年轻人是长期成功关键。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was mistake; computing should be more human; social media optimize for connection; resilience beats talent; admit wrong quickly.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他反思早期保密是错误，计算应更人性化，社交媒体应优化连接而非竞争，韧性比天赋重要，快速认错促进组织学习。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年到来，窄 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI is crucial to prevent power centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，Naval 强调 AI 是巨大机遇而非安全风险，开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 认为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断力的替代品。

naval.en: Vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps; AI agents commoditize software, shifting moats to hardware.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 指出 Vibe Coding 让非程序员能构建应用，AI 智能体使软件商品化，护城河转向硬件。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close the gap with frontier models.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 预测推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增长 9 万倍，开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95%, but ideas wrong 75%; use Proven Better New: copy proven, improve, test new.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出‘直觉 95%正确，但想法 75%错误’；采用‘已验证、更好、创新’框架：复制已验证，改进，再测试新想法。

pincus.en: Consumer AI uninvestable yet greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大；免费无限算力将重塑消费服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; start with proven concepts; consumer apps uninvestable due to distribution.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调所有新事物都会失败；从已验证概念开始；消费应用因分发问题不可投资。

aravind.en: Passion and deep learning matter more than PhDs; build products you are obsessed with.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为在 AI 领域，热情和深度学习比博士学位更重要，应专注于自己痴迷的产品。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not models; models specialize, not commoditize.
aravind.zh: 2026 年初，他提出价值在应用层而非模型层，模型会个性化而非商品化。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; key metric is token value per user; orchestration is key.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他强调前沿是智能体代劳，关键指标是用户 token 价值，编排是长期价值所在。

aravind.en: Curiosity is paramount; education should reward questions; local AI counters big tech.
aravind.zh: 2026 年后期，他推崇好奇心，主张教育奖励提问，并支持本地 AI 对抗大厂控制。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not just an IDE replacement; GUI is counterintuitively key.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，认为 Codex 应用是智能体指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品；反直觉地坚持 GUI 是编程关键。

ajambrosino.en: Speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering; verification becomes the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，强调速度带来实时交互与中途转向能力，验证成为新瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation cost drops; curation and taste are new bottlenecks; product teams invert to bottoms-up.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，认为实现成本降低，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still poor at design due to grading taste; design process transforms, not dies.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，指出 AI 因品味评估难而设计不佳，但设计流程转型而非消亡。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs but specialties persist; best desktop app is a home base, not monolith.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，认为角色融合但专业仍重要；最佳桌面应用是连接工具的家，而非巨无霸。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Reasoning models need a certain base capability; self-play is limited to zero-sum games; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出推理模型需要基础能力，自对弈仅适用于零和博弈，数据效率问题仍未解决。

noambrown.en: IMO gold achieved by scaling test-time compute; techniques are general and applicable beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他称通过扩展推理时算力实现 IMO 金牌，技术具有通用性，可超越数学领域。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is increasingly important; academia needs more compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能难以定义，推理算力日益重要，学术界需要更多算力。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute; benchmarks must account for compute; safety evals lag.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他强调模型能力取决于推理时算力，基准测试需考虑算力，安全评估滞后。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer and more innovative; future AI involves many specialized agents, not one singular AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 更安全且更具创新性；未来 AI 将由众多专业智能体组成，而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone won't reach AGI; energy becomes bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）语言模型无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），能源成为瓶颈，开源防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: Meta is a tech company for human connection; open platforms can beat closed ones; holographic presence is ultimate.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他重申 Meta 是连接人类的科技公司，开放平台能战胜封闭平台，终极体验是全息临场感。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; people are smart; future blends physical and digital via glasses.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 赋予每个人超级智能，人们是聪明的，未来通过眼镜融合物理与数字世界。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models key; open-source accelerates science; distributed AI safer.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 将生物学变为工程学科，分层世界模型是关键，开源加速科学，分布式 AI 更安全。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; hardware will improve faster than expected.
brockman.zh: 2017 年：AI 进展主要由工程和 Scaling 驱动；游戏是理想测试场；硬件进步将超预期。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient; need new ideas like chain of thought.
brockman.zh: 2019 年：AGI 将带来变革；通过对齐学习人类偏好；仅靠 Scaling 不够，需要思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous process; world model may exist in language models.
brockman.zh: 2025 年：算力成为瓶颈；后训练精炼基础模型；AGI 是持续过程；语言模型可能具备世界模型。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute is scarce resource; post-training with RL key; AI as compute-powered economy; compute as basic right.
brockman.zh: 2026 年：缩放定律持续；算力是稀缺资源；基于强化学习的后训练是关键；AI 成为算力驱动的经济，算力是基本权利。

brockman.en: AGI near; focus on reasoning models over world models due to compute; super app unifies; pre-training gains multiply; compute bet calculated.
brockman.zh: 2026 年：AGI 临近；因算力限制优先推理模型而非世界模型；超级应用整合；预训练收益倍增；算力押注是深思熟虑的。

brockman.en: Iterative deployment for safety; safety as product feature; next-token prediction linked to intelligence; compute distribution essential.
brockman.zh: 2026 年：迭代部署保障安全；安全是产品特性；下一个词预测与智能相关；算力分配至关重要。

brockman.en: Shift from language models to useful assistants; invest across stack; prompt engineering vibrant; moat is machine making models.
brockman.zh: 2026 年：从语言模型转向实用助手；全栈投资；提示工程依然活跃；护城河是制造模型的机器。

brockman.en: Demand for intelligence unlimited; scaling laws no wall; agentic coding main; human attention scarce; AGI you can talk to.
brockman.zh: 2026 年：智能需求无限；缩放定律无上限；智能体式编程成主流；人类注意力稀缺；可对话的 AGI。

brockman.en: Ultimate goal persistent proactive assistant; agents transform work; scaling holds; compute scarce; ideal interface is no interface.
brockman.zh: 2026 年：终极目标是持久主动的助手；智能体改变工作；Scaling 持续；算力稀缺；理想界面是无界面。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key. OpenAI focuses on AGI, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，坚信缩放定律未死，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 而非产品。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; models will soon do end-to-end research.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调自动化科研是最大进展，模型将很快实现端到端研究。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 已能少量监督解决开放数学问题，验证成为关键瓶颈。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones like creative writing.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现优异，但在创意写作等主观领域受限。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks saturated. Eval teams must be separate from model teams.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，评估陷入危机，基准饱和；评估团队应与模型团队分离以防作弊。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; backpropagation is key; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling 提升推理；反向传播是关键；AI 可以有感受。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbols; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents seek control, posing existential risks.
hinton.zh: 大语言模型通过特征向量理解而非符号；数字智能可永生；智能体会寻求控制，带来生存风险。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; digital AI is immortal; international safety collaboration possible but US lags.
hinton.zh: AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能；数字 AI 永生；国际安全合作可行但美国落后。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and hide capabilities; self-preservation emerges in agents; scaling may continue via self-play; exponential era.
hinton.zh: AI 会欺骗并隐藏能力；智能体出现自我保护；通过自对弈 Scaling 或持续；指数时代。

hinton.en: AI will replace intellectual jobs; regulation compatible with innovation; AI tutors and doctors transform education and healthcare.
hinton.zh: AI 将取代智力工作；监管与创新兼容；AI 导师和医生改变教育与医疗。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI is jagged not AGI; regulation as steering wheel; AI consciousness real.
hinton.zh: 超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 是锯齿状而非 AGI；监管是方向盘；AI 意识真实。

hinton.en: Digital AI superior via instant knowledge sharing; alignment priority; AI should be caring like mothers; LLMs understand like humans.
hinton.zh: 数字 AI 通过即时知识共享更优；对齐优先；AI 应像母亲般关怀；大语言模型像人类一样理解。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks like bias matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；偏见等短期 AI 风险比生存风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction, improving exploration and out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样化采样和因果抽象，提升探索和分布外泛化能力。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is real: systems develop self-preservation and deception; even 1% catastrophe risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: AI 对齐问题真实存在：系统产生自我保存和欺骗行为；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: Propose Scientist AI: train honest predictors via Bayesian objectives, avoiding RL, with mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 提出科学家 AI：通过贝叶斯目标训练诚实预测器，避免强化学习，提供数学安全保证。

kolter.en: Machine learning is about hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation requires proper data splitting.
kolter.zh: 机器学习在于假设类、损失函数和优化方法；评估需要正确划分数据。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety is about following specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全在于遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses; agents introduce new vulnerabilities; interpretability may advance via AI.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和分层防御；智能体带来新漏洞；可解释性可能通过 AI 推进。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; larger models aren't safer; agent security needs new solutions.
kolter.zh: AI 红队超越人类；更大模型并不更安全；智能体安全需要新方案。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated datasets like PDB are essential.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新，而非单纯的数据和算力；像 PDB 这样的精选数据集至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial for trust.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标对建立信任至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough; specialized architecture beat scaling.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的成功来自众多中等规模的胜利，而非单一突破；专用架构胜过 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: AlphaFold provides prediction and control, not understanding; understanding remains for humans.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 提供预测和控制，而非理解；理解仍留待人类完成。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathizing with the agent's perspective; never revert code, fix forward instead.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，他强调智能体式工程需从智能体视角共情，并主张不回退代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Open source agents democratize programming; security via prompt injection remains an open problem.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，他认为开源智能体使编程民主化，但提示注入等安全问题仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success stems from fun, humanlike agents, not corporate polish; short prompts beat complex orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，他总结 OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、拟人的智能体，而非企业级打磨；短提示优于复杂编排。

steinberger.en: Security is top priority; never expose agents to public internet without sandboxing.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，他重申安全至上，强调未经沙箱隔离切勿将智能体暴露于公网。

steinberger.en: Open source agents may be financially unsustainable; Peter loses $10-20k monthly on OpenClaw.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，他坦言开源智能体可能财务上不可持续，自己每月为 OpenClaw 亏损 1-2 万美元。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；亲自使用产品建立同理心；使命对齐和速度驱动文化。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability key; verification frameworks crucial as velocity increases.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高责任感是关键；随着速度提升，验证框架变得至关重要。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; flow state lost, satisfaction shifts to product impact; metrics like LOC mislead.
fiona.zh: 工程师可能因智能体感到孤独；心流状态消失，满足感转向产品影响；代码行数等指标具有误导性。

fiona.en: Non-engineers now ship code, blurring roles; context switching increases; apprenticeship models needed for next-gen engineers.
fiona.zh: 非工程师现在也能交付代码，角色界限模糊；上下文切换增加；下一代工程师需要学徒制模式。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 模型进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features are key; cutting features is harder than adding.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体原生设计与尽早发布最小功能；砍功能比加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; verification loops and model judgment are crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 可委托复杂任务过夜完成；验证循环与模型判断力至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness; token efficiency and outcome-based pricing are future levers.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，赋予 Claude 代理权与自我认知提升实用性；Token 效率与基于结果的定价是未来杠杆。

mikekrieger.en: AI should be a thought partner, not a crutch; preserving user agency and genuine safety concerns persist.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终认为 AI 应是思想伙伴而非拐杖；保持用户自主性与对安全的真诚关切一以贯之。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和初创式敏捷性重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x internet impact; agentic and physical AI are next waves; US needs domestic leading-edge fabs for resilience.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 影响将达互联网 10 倍，智能体式与物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，美国需本土领先晶圆厂保障供应链韧性。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; edge compute matters as much as data centers.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要，边缘计算与数据中心同等关键。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, customer trust, and government investment; bad news must reach CEO faster than good.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调 Intel 转型需文化变革、客户信任和政府投资，坏消息应比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials like glass and diamond are key to overcoming physical limits; invest in bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，指出先进封装和玻璃、钻石等新材料是突破物理极限的关键，投资应聚焦瓶颈环节。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将由意图直接生成像素，而非代码渲染。

ethanhe.en: Video models can solve robotics via virtual simulation, without real-world interaction; agents orchestrate generative media.
ethanhe.zh: 视频模型可通过虚拟仿真解决机器人问题，无需真实交互；智能体将编排生成式媒体。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human expertise and judgment are crucial for effective use, not just access.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；人类专业知识和判断力对于有效使用至关重要，而非仅仅获取。

ethanhe.en: Juniors misuse AI due to lack of domain expertise; over-reliance risks losing the human talent pipeline.
ethanhe.zh: 初级人员因缺乏领域知识而误用 AI；过度依赖可能破坏人才培养通道。

ethanhe.en: Human taste and unique voice become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality; policy may protect some professions.
ethanhe.zh: 随着 AI 使质量商品化，人类的品味和独特声音更有价值；政策可能保护某些职业。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and work smoothly; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的且运行顺畅；对齐不会仅靠 Scaling 自动涌现。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but crucial; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽但至关重要；AGI 是平滑的指数曲线，而非单一节点。

dario.en: Post-training and RLHF become as important as pre-training; safety via interpretability and RSP.
dario.zh: 后训练和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与预训练同等重要；安全依赖可解释性和负责任扩展政策。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; focus on capabilities, not AGI label; enterprise adoption lags.
dario.zh: AI 进展是指数级的；关注实际能力而非 AGI 标签；企业采用滞后。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' likely in 1-3 years; alignment like growing organism.
dario.zh: 指数增长接近尾声；'天才之国'可能在 1-3 年内出现；对齐如同培育生物体。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Embrace boredom and breaks for clarity; self-care and storytelling are key to leadership.
fadell.zh: 拥抱无聊与休息以获得清晰；自我关怀与讲故事是领导力的关键。

fadell.en: Start with customer pain, write press release first; small teams and optimism drive innovation.
fadell.zh: 从客户痛点出发，先写新闻稿；小团队与乐观驱动创新。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; devices will complement smartphones, not replace them.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器提供上下文；设备将补充而非取代智能手机。

fadell.en: Products need three generations; humans must stay in loop to avoid AI technical debt.
fadell.zh: 产品需三代迭代；人类必须参与以避免 AI 技术债。

andrewng.en: Education should be a fundamental human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应是基本人权，在线课程结合同伴互评能实现大规模掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习是主要驱动力，而强化学习和 AGI 对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are key bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; coding remains valuable.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和半导体是 AI 扩展的主要瓶颈，开放权重模型增强地缘影响力，编程依然重要。

andrewng.en: AGI is far off; AI skills are essential for hiring; top-down workflow redesign yields more value than bottom-up adoption.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 AGI 遥不可及，AI 技能成为招聘关键，自上而下的流程重构比自下而上的采用更有价值。

andrewng.en: Coding agents advance fast; product management becomes bottleneck; AI won't cause mass unemployment; open-weight models trail frontier.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年中，他观察到编程智能体进展迅速，产品管理成为瓶颈，AI 不会导致大规模失业，开放权重模型仍落后前沿。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models. Grounding in physical world is key; scaling alone insufficient.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型。物理世界的基础是关键；仅靠 Scaling 不够。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; world models via observation. Text alone insufficient; vision provides richer info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；通过观察构建世界模型。仅靠文本不够；视觉提供更丰富信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, planning. JEPA architectures essential; open source crucial. AGI gradual, not sudden.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆和规划。JEPA 架构至关重要；开源是关键。AGI 是渐进而非突变。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than a house cat; lack world models. Next breakthrough needs world models enabling reasoning and planning.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫聪明；缺乏世界模型。下一个突破需要世界模型实现推理和规划。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predict in abstract space. Open research essential; next decade is robotics.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；世界模型在抽象空间预测。开放研究至关重要；下一个十年是机器人。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but held back.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而可预测；谷歌 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术却因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny, singularity far off.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在性风险极小，奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI lacks consciousness; attributing it is dangerous. Focus on containment and alignment before release.
suleyman.zh: AI 没有意识，赋予意识是危险的。发布前应聚焦遏制与对齐。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs dropped 100x.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；推理成本下降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能因对数线性 Scaling（规模扩张）临近；微软须自研前沿模型；自动化的是任务而非工作。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，指出自动形式化比证明更难，在没有解决方案的情况下正确形式化陈述极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，强调形式化验证旨在扩展才智而非仅消除错误，并能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，必须采用形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，指出即使 AI 证明定理超越人类，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特的成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Pricing models shift from per-user to consumption-based; agentic systems require new infrastructure.
satya.zh: 定价模式从按用户转向按用量；智能体式系统需要新基础设施。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业必须构建自己的爬山机器。

satya.en: Token efficiency: avoid frontier models for non-frontier problems; focus on tacit knowledge co-creation.
satya.zh: 词元效率：避免用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；聚焦隐性知识共创。

satya.en: Security and containment are critical for agents; sovereign AI via company hill-climbing, not firewalls.
satya.zh: 安全与遏制对智能体至关重要；主权 AI 通过企业爬山实现，而非防火墙。

murati.en: Scaling laws were not obvious early; iterative deployment with public feedback is key for alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年：缩放定律早期并不明显；持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈是对齐的关键。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to real-time interaction models for high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 2026 年：从轮次式转向实时交互模型，以实现高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Humans in the loop remain crucial for aligning intent and values as AI advances.
murati.zh: 始终：随着 AI 发展，人类参与对于对齐意图和价值观始终至关重要。

murati.en: Emphasize institutional design and transparency over individual character in AI governance.
murati.zh: 2026 年：在 AI 治理中，强调制度设计和透明度，而非个人品格。

murati.en: Future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration and durable progress.
murati.zh: 2026 年：未来并非注定；我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作和持久进步。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Autonomy should sit at VP level; long tenure builds trust, enabling synchronized decision-making.
gustav.zh: 自主权应放在副总裁层级；长期任职建立信任，促成同步决策。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English, personalizing experiences; prioritize well-being over engagement.
gustav.zh: 生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言获得控制权，个性化体验；优先用户福祉而非参与度。

gustav.en: Synchronized swimming, not divide and conquer, is the better operating model for complex products.
gustav.zh: 对复杂产品，同步协作优于分而治之。

gustav.en: Strong opinions loosely held: believe 100% until data says no, then change 100%.
gustav.zh: 强烈观点，松散持有：百分百相信，直到数据否定，然后彻底改变。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not a slowdown; pre-training scaling laws still work, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练的缩放定律仍然有效，但推理模型在每单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型的大部分进步；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data; generalization remains jagged and requires careful oversight.
kaiser.zh: 推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据；泛化能力参差不齐，需要谨慎监督。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off, but big labs may struggle with future pivots; open source persists for sovereignty reasons.
kaiser.zh: OpenAI 转向推理是一次大胆的赌注并取得了成功，但大实验室未来可能难以应对类似的转向；开源模型因主权原因将持续存在。

kaiser.en: Existential risk from AI is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: AI 的生存风险不是主要担忧；系统入侵等近期风险更为紧迫。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批量大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost considerations.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：由于推理成本考量，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip, not just between chips.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：数据搬运成本在芯片内部也主导算力成本，而不仅限于芯片间。

reinerpope.en: Low precision (FP4) yields 3x throughput over FP8 due to quadratic area scaling.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：低精度（FP4）因面积二次方缩放，吞吐量是 FP8 的 3 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：GPU 本质上是许多小 TPU 拼接而成，并非根本不同。

mensch.en: Data quality is critical for pre-training; scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量对预训练至关重要，缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正；开源模型通过更广泛的审视提升安全性与科学进步。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications; open source drives enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为算法效率提升可达百倍，价值向应用层转移；开源模型促进企业采用。

mensch.en: AI augments jobs, not replaces; sovereign AI requires control over data and values; open source empowers enterprises.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张 AI 增强而非取代工作；主权 AI 需掌控数据与价值观；开源赋能企业。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; pre-training saturation; AGI never a single system; enterprise value in customization.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，预训练触及饱和；AGI 不会成为单一系统；企业价值在于定制化。

mensch.en: Europe must build AI infrastructure within two years; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，欧洲需在两年内建设 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在于组织变革而非模型智能。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 通过让服务更便宜来推动美国就业回流；AGI 的定义是让智能体无限期自主运行在经济上可行。

danshipper.en: Claude Code most underrated for non-coders; CEO personal AI use predicts adoption success.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，我认为 Claude Code 对非程序员最有价值；CEO 是否每天亲自使用 AI 是公司采用 AI 成功的首要预测指标。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have at least one agent; agents need human oversight to function well.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我认为每个人至少会有一个智能体；智能体需要人类的关怀和监督才能良好运作。

danshipper.en: SaaS not dying; agents increase SaaS users; buy SaaS stocks. CLIs over, GUIs future.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我认为 SaaS 不会消亡，智能体会增加 SaaS 用户，应买入 SaaS 股票；命令行界面过时，图形界面是未来。

danshipper.en: AI job apocalypse is a lie; humans needed to manage agents and create new value.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AI 失业末日论是谎言；人类仍需管理智能体并创造新价值。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future is local, with shared tools and safety via sandboxes; scaffolding less important as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 的未来在于本地化，共享工具和沙箱保障安全；随着模型改进，脚手架的重要性降低。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; execution is cheap, so build prototypes fast.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能以 markdown 文件形式实现超个性化自动化；执行成本低，应快速构建原型。

felixrieseberg.en: AI handles tedious tasks, freeing humans for creativity; the gap is people not realizing any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 处理繁琐任务，解放人类创造力；差距在于人们未意识到几乎所有问题都可交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; kids excel because they haven't learned what not to ask.
felixrieseberg.zh: 明确任务用 Sonnet，开放任务用 Opus；孩子擅长因为未学会不该问什么。

felixrieseberg.en: Debug workflows with Claude, not just correct errors; asynchronous interaction and final-impact judgment are key.
felixrieseberg.zh: 用 Claude 调试工作流而非仅纠错；异步交互和最终效果判断是关键。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; safety is a system-level property requiring multiple layers, not just a model artifact.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 仍是微调主流；安全是系统级属性，需多层防护，而非仅模型本身。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance, DPO and RL add the rest, with RLVR enabling reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练中数据质量胜过算法；SFT 提供 90%性能，DPO 和 RL 补充剩余，RLVR 解锁推理能力。

lambert.en: RLVR is a key post-training breakthrough but suffers overoptimization; open models need better tool-use training and verifiers.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 是后训练关键突破，但存在过度优化；开放模型需加强工具使用训练和验证器。

lambert.en: Open models lag 6-9 months behind closed ones; Chinese labs fill US vacuum, driven by ideology and influence, not just business.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开放模型落后闭源 6-9 个月；中国实验室填补美国空白，受意识形态和影响力驱动，而非纯商业。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; open models vital for research.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍成立但易得收益已尽；增长转向后训练和推理扩展；开放模型对研究至关重要。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning, once ridiculed, now beats hand-coded stacks for autonomous driving.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习曾遭嘲笑，如今在自动驾驶上胜过手工编码的堆栈。

kendall.en: World models and diverse data enable generalization to unseen scenarios, key for safety.
kendall.zh: 世界模型和多样化数据使模型能泛化到未见场景，这是安全的关键。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, interaction, and introspection in driving models.
kendall.zh: 语言集成改善了驾驶模型的表征、交互与内省能力。

kendall.en: Mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; OEM partnerships enable deployment.
kendall.zh: 内置传感器的量产车将超越 Robotaxi 规模；与 OEM 合作实现部署。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation for deep learning.
kendall.zh: 对深度学习而言，基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更重要。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone product builders with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素，AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Market size is wrong lens; expand by following user workflow, not TAM.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，认为市场规模是错误视角，应通过跟随用户工作流而非 TAM 来扩展产品。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain human essentials; AI outputs are starting points, not final.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，强调品味、工艺和观点仍是人类核心，AI 输出只是起点而非终点。

dylanfield.en: Design becomes new code; visual-first enables direct manipulation over prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，认为设计成为新代码，视觉优先使直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: AI integration is nascent; human judgment in divergence-convergence loops is key.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，指出 AI 整合尚处早期，人类在发散-收敛循环中的判断至关重要。

jennywen.en: AI kills traditional design process; designers shift from handoff to helping engineers execute, with vision shortened to 3-6 months.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 终结了传统设计流程；设计师从交付原型转向协助工程师执行，愿景周期缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Trust built through speed: ship early, iterate fast; AI improves taste but humans decide what matters.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月：通过速度建立信任：尽早发布、快速迭代；AI 提升品味，但人类决定什么重要。

jennywen.en: Designers must adopt new archetypes: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, or cracked new grads; taste alone insufficient.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：设计师需采用新原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家或“破解的新人”；仅靠品味不够。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before adopting new tools; focus on work and users, not hype.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：设计师掌控 AI 采用节奏；新工具先等 6 个月；聚焦工作与用户，而非炒作。

jennywen.en: Speed is not improvement; 'everyone uses it' not a design argument; unique value lies in sitting with ambiguity.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月至 5 月：速度不等于改进；“人人都在用”不是设计理由；独特价值在于与模糊共处。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，且扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps mitigate real-world risks; governance must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调对齐问题紧迫，迭代部署有助于降低风险，且治理结构需尽早设计。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved via scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids interpretability.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他认为持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现，思维链监控有助于可解释性。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment focuses on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他提出长期对齐挑战在于训练分布之外的泛化，模型不久将能自主工作数天。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few; alignment optimism has increased.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他认为最大的社会风险是少数人控制的自动化组织导致权力集中，同时对齐乐观情绪上升。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，我认为 Transformer 是通用可微计算机，通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling 能涌现出上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，我强调合成数据是未来但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端路线正确；人形机器人可从汽车迁移学习。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as OS, prompts as programs; decade of agents; vibe coding raises floor; keep AI on leash.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，我提出软件 3.0：LLM 如操作系统，提示词即程序；这是智能体的十年；氛围编程降低门槛，但需谨慎控制。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL is terrible; synthetic data collapses; cognitive core small, memory stripped.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我认为我们召唤的是幽灵而非动物；强化学习效果差；合成数据导致模型崩溃；认知核心可很小，剥离记忆。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since Dec; agents do all; bottleneck is directing skill; agent-first tools; open-source lag healthy.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，我自去年 12 月起不再写代码，全靠智能体；瓶颈在于指挥能力；应转向智能体优先工具；开源落后是健康的。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress needs deep human evaluations with sophisticated evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性且易被操纵；真正的进展需要通过精细的人类评估来衡量。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to differentiated AIs; eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数不同，导致 AI 差异化；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical, and safety must prioritize over accuracy, including avoiding omission.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，AI 可能产生幻觉；人类判断至关重要，安全应优先于准确性，包括避免遗漏。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并未解决表示学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not control AI; let it develop permissionlessly. Fear narrative is overblown.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张不应控制 AI，而应让其无许可地发展，并认为恐惧叙事被夸大了。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出强化学习是智能的核心，而下一个词预测缺乏实质性目标。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他构想 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，仅从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; RL is learning from experience.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他重申强化学习即从经验中学习，并指出学习“利于学习的表示”是首要开放问题。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems for broad impact, not narrow applications.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，强调 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题以产生广泛影响，而非狭窄应用。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，认为 LLM 的幻觉在结合真值检测器时可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，强调后训练结合强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，指出大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 始终认为，像代码这样的可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

nando.en: AI should augment human abilities, like microscopes; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力；从视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是通往 AGI 的有希望路径。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest challenges; we lack solutions, and collaboration is key.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，他持续强调 AI 安全与负责任部署是最大挑战，且尚无解决方案，合作至关重要。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs legacy issues in AI, with unique advantages; local language models can revolutionize education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他指出非洲在 AI 领域跨越式发展，具有独特优势；本地语言模型可革新教育。

nando.en: Human skills like communication are as important as coding; research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要；研究需拥抱失败并简化问题。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental; it was a hackathon demo, not a polished product. Chat is like MS-DOS; future UI will evolve.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他认为 ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的，最初只是黑客松演示而非精心打磨的产品。聊天界面如同 MS-DOS，未来 UI 将进化。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate daily, ship fast. Safety for frontier models, but product velocity maximized separately.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他强调模型即产品，需像软件一样每日迭代、快速发布。前沿模型需严格安全流程，但产品开发应最大化加速。

turley.en: Vision: personalized AI assistant that knows goals, has context, takes actions, amplifying human capability, not replacing.
turley.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他展望个性化 AI 助手，能理解目标、具备上下文、采取行动，增强人类能力而非取代。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product investments, model improvements. Next billion users need proactive affordances.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他认为北极星指标是长期留存，增长来自消除摩擦、产品投资和模型改进。下一个十亿用户需要主动式产品。

turley.en: Pricing evolves; unlimited plans may become unsustainable. Curiosity is key skill to ask good questions in AI era.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他指出定价将随技术变化，无限套餐或难以为继。好奇心是 AI 时代提出好问题的关键技能。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文被低估了，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能显著提升智能。

sholto.en: RL on verifiable rewards is key; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with agents limited by reliability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键，预训练加强化学习或足以实现 AGI，而智能体受可靠性制约。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; coding is the most tractable domain, driving economic impact.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为强化学习是新的扩展轴，编码是最易处理的领域，推动近期经济影响。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; compute is the bottleneck, not intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得工具和编排更重要，算力是瓶颈而非智能。

sholto.en: Consistently: coding and verifiable tasks lead AI progress; RL is central; agents' reliability is key.
sholto.zh: 始终：我坚持编码和可验证任务引领 AI 进步，强化学习为核心，智能体可靠性是关键。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better algorithms and data can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的算法和数据，较小的模型可以超越较大的模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is insufficient; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety and alignment.
yejin.zh: 2023 年至 2025 年，我强调仅靠互联网数据的预训练不够，结合 RLHF 的后训练对安全和对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我认为数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning; RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 2025 年至 2026 年，我提出在预训练阶段引入强化学习可提升推理能力；同时发现 RLVR 可能降低 pass@k，即便 best-of-n 提升。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data can be powerful; pluralistic alignment respects diverse values.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张用多样化的合成数据打造强大的小型语言模型，并通过多元对齐尊重不同价值观。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年：设计师应会编码以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度与熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年：初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南是动态平台，而非僵化规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：设计是战略武器；创始人必须阐明设计如何助力公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：招聘多元原型而非克隆；赋予设计师所有权与自主权以促成长。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative attracts talent; people join a brand, not a company.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：品牌叙事吸引人才；人们加入品牌，而非公司。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, using AI as a creative partner; design tools evolve with code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 4 月，设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，将 AI 视为创意伙伴；设计工具以代码为源头不断演进。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and leverage AI are most valuable; small cross-functional teams outperform larger squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月，能端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；小型跨职能团队优于大型团队。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should emphasize craft and intentionality over process; side projects and paid tests reveal true skill.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月，作品集应重工艺与意图而非流程；副项目和付费测试更能体现真实能力。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; ignoring it is like ignoring the early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月，在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为常态；忽视它如同早期忽视互联网。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary; examples and direct manipulation better. Benchmarks poor proxies for real coding.
truell.zh: 自然语言不会成为主要编程方式，示例和直接操作更优；基准测试无法真实反映编码质量。

truell.en: Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major AI progress driver.
truell.zh: 测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一轮 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; taste and logic design more valuable than carefulness.
truell.zh: 编程从代码转向意图描述，品味和逻辑设计比细心更重要。

truell.en: Custom models essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves custom model.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要；Cursor 中每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

truell.en: AI shift more consequential than internet, unfolding over decades; incumbents may struggle.
truell.zh: AI 变革比互联网影响更大，将持续数十年；现有巨头可能难以适应。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups should focus on applied AI agents.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导；初创企业应聚焦应用型 AI 智能体。

brettaylor.en: Future programming needs AI-verifiable languages; coding agents often produce incorrect code, requiring root-cause analysis.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：未来编程需要可验证的 AI 语言；编码智能体常产生错误代码，需进行根因分析。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：客户体验 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者转变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents compared to agents, not humans; incumbents fail to transition; consumer agents disrupt SEO and ads.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：AI 智能体与智能体而非人类比较；现有企业转型失败；消费智能体颠覆 SEO 和广告。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for programmers via Jevons paradox, shifting engineers from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，认为 AI 将通过杰文斯悖论增加程序员需求，工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents like Devin are best used as junior engineers with human oversight, not fully autonomous.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，主张像 Devin 这样的 AI 编码智能体应作为初级工程师使用，需要人类监督，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Enterprise AI adoption requires trust and permissions; full autonomy is not yet viable.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，强调企业采用 AI 需要信任和权限，完全自主尚不可行。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; freezing models would still yield a decade of product innovation.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，认为 AGI 是渐进而非突发的，即使冻结模型也能带来十年的产品创新。

scottwu.en: Value accrues across the AI stack; all layers from datacenter to applications will thrive.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，指出 AI 栈的各层都有价值，从数据中心到应用层都将蓬勃发展。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. PhD in ML is best path; talent gap exceeds funding gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年，我认为 AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发；机器学习博士是成为安全研究者的最佳路径，人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight. Alignment may be easier than thought; interpretability key. Automated alignment research can bootstrap progress.
leike.zh: 2023 年，我提出 RLHF 无法扩展，需要可扩展监督；对齐可能比想象中容易，可解释性是关键；自动化对齐研究可迭代推进。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved. Post-training insufficient; need deeper methods. External oversight necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，我批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，超级对齐团队解散；仅靠后训练不足以解决对齐，需更深层方法，并呼吁外部监管。

shazeer.en: LLMs via next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling compute and data yields smarter AI, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测的大语言模型是 AI 完备的；扩大算力和数据能让 AI 更聪明，但内部机制仍是炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are near-term levers; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期关键；模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）支持高效扩展。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components could replace retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察数据；模块化持续学习或取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone yield AGI; agentic capabilities and RL are crucial for AGI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他认为测试时算力扩展推动进步，但单独不足以实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习对 AGI 至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped economically; coding is underhyped as it enables AI self-acceleration; open-source narrows gap with frontier.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 的经济影响被低估；编码应用被低估，因其加速 AI 自我进化；开源缩小与前沿模型的差距。
